resources.string: Open one of your teams on fantasy.basketnews.com (EuroLeague). The app picks it up automatically.
Unofficial, not affiliated with BasketNews or EuroLeague.

Live points = EFF from the live EuroLeague box score, +10% if the player\'s team is winning, −10% if losing (while a game is live: whoever leads right now). Captain x2 (x3 with Triple Captain), starters and sixth player x1, bench x0.5 (x1 with Bench Boost). BasketNews publishes its own official numbers after the games.
Your Android System WebView is too old. Update it from the Play Store to see live points.

Google, Facebook and Apple don\'t allow signing in inside other apps, and a login done in Chrome isn\'t shared with this app.\n\nPlease log in to BasketNews with your email and password here instead. If you created your account with Google, use \"Forgot password\" on the BasketNews login page to set a password for the same email first.
